scope: Real product entry (validation/tauri/index.html + src/main.js) served by the project dev server and driven in headless Chrome with a local mock Tauri bridge. The ordinary SSH page was reached through the real home navigation (home-open-ssh -> setHomeSection('ssh')); no real host was contacted and no native build was used.

viewport.note: CSS width 320 / 390 at DPR 2; the PNG pixel width is twice the CSS width.

mockBridge.kind: injected local mock of the Tauri invoke/Channel bridge
mockBridge.hostList: host_init / host_list / network_list return empty local lists, so the home board shows '0 台已存主机' and no unreachable-host banner
mockBridge.fingerprintSource: crypto.getRandomValues over 32 bytes, base64 encoded, so both old and new fingerprints have the real SHA256 length and wrap on narrow widths

navigation.entry: home board -> 普通 SSH -> probe -> confirm -> connect -> refused handshake -> review view
navigation.finalRoute: ordinary SSH section (nav-terminal pressed); the home board and the host panel are not visible

notCovered: Real macOS window rendering of the same review view
